subtitle: Lesson 14 · Index & Statistics Administration

eyebrow: A rebuild has a cost too
code:
ALTER INDEX IX_Orders_CustomerID
  ON dbo.Orders REBUILD;

-- fully logged: large log volume,
-- competes with app writes for log I/O
caption: On a busy OLTP table at the wrong time, this can cause the slowness it's meant to fix.

code:
ALTER INDEX IX_Orders_CustomerID
  ON dbo.Orders
  REBUILD WITH (ONLINE = ON);

-- still takes a brief schema-mod lock
-- adds tempdb + log overhead of its own
caption: "Online" describes concurrency, not the resource cost of the operation.
